title: Lunar Arsenal
description: Lunar Arsenal adds a new way to improve and maintain your precious tools.
body:
![Lunar Arsenal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8290bfefedb1b3b3ea9f1144cf0f31b30400fd76.png)

Lunar Arsenal adds a new way to improve and maintain your precious tools.

- Collect unique gems that can be used to enhance your tools.
- Craft a Forge Table where you can refine materials, craft potent weapons and tools, and repair tools that look a little wear for worse.
- Create 4 unique weapons with different use cases. The Mallet, Rapier, Scythe, and War Buckler should change up combat for the better.
